payload.comment: Training stage is internally consistent and well-executed. All 15 epochs completed with no early-stopping trigger; validation accuracy improved from 0.9433 (epoch 1) to 0.9965 (epoch 15) with a minor, recoverable dip at epoch 9 (0.9911 vs 0.9929 at epoch 8), which is normal under a cosine schedule. The cosine LR schedule is correctly implemented (verified at epochs 1, 5, 10, 15 against the analytic formula). Test metrics were not used (test_locked=true, test_metrics_used=false). All five architecture families were evaluated across 8 trials with 0 failures. Checkpoint and config integrity hashes are present. Minor observations (none deterministic): (1) The 'resnet18' model_family label coexists with transformer-style fields (patch_size, num_heads, positional_encoding, tokenizer_layers, pooling=cls), creating naming ambiguity that could confuse downstream consumers; a more descriptive family name would be preferable. (2) early_stopping_patience=3 is below the commonly recommended 10–15, though it did not trigger here since val accuracy kept improving. (3) The final training config (epochs=15, patience=3) differs from the search-trial config (epochs=9, patience=5) yet shares the same config_hash, implying the hash covers architecture but not training-budget parameters—defensible but worth documenting. (4) The augmentation set (hflip, vflip, rotate180) deviates from the research-recommended set (hflip, rotation ±10°, translation ±2px); the choice is defensible for 28×28 pathology tiles but the rationale does not explicitly justify the deviation. None of these rise to a deterministic finding; the stage is ready to proceed.
llm_issues: model_family='resnet18' combined with transformer-style config fields (patch_size, num_heads, positional_encoding, tokenizer_layers, pooling=cls) is ambiguous; a clearer family identifier would reduce downstream confusion
early_stopping_patience=3 is below the commonly recommended 10-15 range; did not trigger in this run but could cause premature stopping in less stable runs

config_hash is shared between the 9-epoch search trial and the 15-epoch final training despite differing epochs and patience values; the hash scope (architecture-only vs full config) should be documented
Augmentation set (hflip, vflip, rotate180) deviates from the research-recommended set (hflip, rotation ±10°, translation ±2px) without explicit justification in the rationale
